promotion_target.summary: Promote the V8 x Recoverable Regret v0.2 Phase-0 measurement instrument (tools/regret.py, tools/regret_reference.py) from "designed" (FCR-V8RR-004) to "certified" — cleared to run over available V8 development data as Phase 1's opportunity-accounting substrate. This is a MEASUREMENT INSTRUMENT promotion, not an economic promotion; the verdict on every store it processes stays NO_ECONOMIC_CLAIM absent an authority receipt (rule 9, rule 12).

open_risks.summary: Three risks carried forward into Phase 1, none blocking promotion at the Phase-0 boundary.

items.label: RISK
items.text: funding_r/gross_utility are None (not fabricated as 0.0) for every real-tape cube row, because CounterfactualOutcome does not persist funding_paid_r and the adapter refuses to guess it. Phase 1's opportunity accounting must read net_utility as authoritative and must not attempt a gross/funding breakdown from the cube alone.
evidence_refs: tools/regret.py (module docstring, "Two contract gaps discovered during implementation")

items.label: RISK
items.text: Only BTCUSDT was reconciled on real data this session; the other 5 downloaded symbols (ETHUSDT, SOLUSDT, BNBUSDT, XRPUSDT, DOGEUSDT) are UNMEASURED until Phase 1 runs one store per symbol (lab.py's single-instrument constraint, not a evaluator limitation).

items.label: RISK
items.text: The downloaded real tape required a 3-day trim before its true end to avoid a funding-coverage-boundary ValueError (the tape's last funding row is 2026-06-30 16:00 UTC; a position open past that needs a boundary the schedule does not carry). Phase 1 must apply the same trim per symbol rather than rediscovering the failure mode per store.
evidence_refs: command run in this session (ValueError funding schedule missing boundary 1782864000000000000, then resolved by trimming 3 days)

signoff_requirements.summary: Per V8_CONSTITUTION rule 12 and the frozen FCR amendment rule 5 - this promotion authorizes MEASUREMENT ONLY, never an economic claim.

items.label: DECISION
items.text: No human sign-off is required to promote a read-only, additive research instrument that touches no Expert, no geometry, and no economic parameter — consistent with how tools/diagnostics.py (authority NONE) is already treated in this repository. An operator sign-off IS required before any future step attempts to attach an authority_receipt or make an economic claim from this instrument's output (rule 9, rule 12) — that is explicitly out of scope for Phase 0/1.
